attribute_descriptions.strength: Raises melee damage and improves the bonus from equipped weapons.
attribute_descriptions.agility: Improves accuracy, dodging attacks, firearm damage, hiding, and fleeing.
attribute_descriptions.intellect: Raises spell damage, healing, starting mana, mana gained on level up, and experience earned.
attribute_descriptions.vitality: Raises starting health, health gained on level up, armor effectiveness, and guarding.

races.name: Human
races.description: Adaptable people from every corner of the world.

races.name: Halfling
races.description: Small, resilient travelers with a talent for escaping danger.

races.name: Gnome
races.description: Curious inventors and keepers of unusual lore.

equipment.name: Training Sword
equipment.description: A serviceable blade for a new adventurer.

classes.name: Guardian
classes.description: A protector who stands firm under pressure.

equipment.name: Worn Shield
equipment.description: A sturdy shield with a few old scratches.

classes.name: Scholar
classes.description: A student of forgotten places and lore.

equipment.name: Travel Staff
equipment.description: A balanced staff for the road.

classes.name: Scout
classes.description: A resourceful traveler who survives by moving lightly.

equipment.name: Scout Knife
equipment.description: A simple blade carried by travelers.

classes.name: Mystic
classes.description: A wandering healer who draws strength from old magic.

equipment.name: Mystic Rod
equipment.description: A carved rod carried by healers.

classes.name: Raider
classes.description: An aggressive skirmisher who relies on speed and steel.

equipment.name: Raider Axe
equipment.description: A light axe suited to rapid strikes.

skills.name: Arms
skills.description: General melee training. Each rank adds 1 melee damage; landing melee blows improves it.

skills.name: Marksmanship
skills.description: Firearm handling. Each rank adds 1 firearm damage, every 2 ranks add 1 accuracy with firearm-category guns, and it grants proficiency with them; landing shots improves it.

skills.name: Guard
skills.description: Each rank reduces incoming damage by 1; taking real blows or bracing with /defend improves it.

skills.name: Lore
skills.description: Each rank adds 2% experience from adventures and quests; earning experience improves it, faster for larger rewards.

skills.name: Blades
skills.description: Swords, knives, and other blade-category weapons. Grants proficiency and +1 melee damage with blades every 2 ranks.

skills.name: Heavy Weapons
skills.description: Axes, maces, staves, and other blunt or axe-category weapons. Grants proficiency and +1 melee damage with them every 2 ranks.

skills.name: Light Armor
skills.description: Leathers and padded gear. Grants proficiency with light-category armor and +1 mitigation in it every 3 ranks.

skills.name: Heavy Armor
skills.description: Plate, mail, and shields. Grants proficiency with heavy and shield-category gear and +1 mitigation with them every 2 ranks.

skills.name: Evocation
skills.description: Each rank adds 1 damage to offensive spells; casting them improves it.

skills.name: Restoration
skills.description: Each rank adds 2 health to healing spells; casting them improves it.

skills.name: Stealth
skills.description: Each rank adds 3% to hiding and slipping past enemies (up to +30%); hiding improves it.

skills.name: Evasion
skills.description: Each rank adds 1 evasion against attacks (up to +15) and 2% to escape chance (up to +20%); dodging and fleeing improve it.

skills.name: Perception
skills.description: Each rank adds 5 to searches for well-hidden discoveries; searching improves it.

skills.name: Lockpicking
skills.description: Each rank adds 5 to /pick attempts on pickable locks; picking locks improves it.

skills.name: Haggling
skills.description: Each rank takes 2% off merchant prices (up to 30%); buying improves it.
